event_summary: A black sphere on a slender dark stem slowly shifts to the right while the green base and surrounding scene remain fixed.
raw_event_description: The video shows a black spherical object attached to the top of a narrow dark stem emerging from a bright green rectangular base behind a wooden foreground edge. Across the clip, the sphere and the upper part of the stem gradually move rightward and slightly lower relative to the base and wall, while the base, tabletop edge, and background remain in place. No visible separation, breakage, or sudden emission occurs.

reasons: The sphere, stem, and green base are visible.
The lower part of the setup is partly hidden by the wooden foreground edge.
The visible motion appears already in progress rather than beginning abruptly in the first frame.
